name: status-collector-pack-drift
title: Status collector reports pack drift as healthy in a consumer repository
description: sd-status local mode cannot resolve a target pack version, so an installed pack behind the source checkout reports packState "installed" and SD status: healthy with no anomaly. Decide between an upstream fix to the vendored collector and local-only guidance.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Vendored collector (manifest files[30], install: "always"), so a behaviour change is an upstream pull request against sd-ai-command-pack needing explicit per-PR approval. Instance of the vendored-artifact pattern whose canonical membership table lives in 08-07-vendored-artifact-upstream-route/prd.md. Ordered after 08-06-task-create-base-branch-default (order 50) in the quality-guidelines.md landing cluster. Observed 2026-08-07: installed 0.64.3 vs source 0.64.24 reported healthy.
